evidence: Rejected scrapping the filibuster on Fox & Friends, saying Republicans would not back it and warning Democrats would add DC/PR states (Oct 2025).
On CNBC, called Warren-style Medicare for All a complete government takeover of health care with higher taxes and longer waits (Nov 2019).
Said DC statehood runs against the Founders intent and is a Democratic bid to add two liberal senators (Apr 2021); again warned against DC/PR states (Oct 2025).
Dismissed Biden's federal gas tax holiday as a political gimmick, saying the country needs a holiday from Biden energy policies instead (Jun 2022).
Voted for the Tax Relief for American Families and Workers Act (H.R. 7024), a narrower CTC expansion raising the refundable portion (Jan 2024, 357-70).
